reasoning_summary:
Accepted the auditor's correction in substance on all 25 flagged lines (13 WRONG, 12 DOUBTFUL); no WRONG verdict disputed.
Line-crossing fixes: 4.3/4.4 (neque/nequisse double negative restored, unresolved), 4.6/4.7 (negat 'denies' + negare), 4.20 (simul), 7.11/7.12 (possint), 10.9/10.10 (esse), 11.7/11.8 (colorat/aequora), 11.11 (-que).
Grammar fixes: 8.10 quae is feminine singular ('her who flees'); 5.6 est...dormienda periphrastic; 6.12 stupra object of tacere; 11.13 voluntas subject; 6.7 nequiquam with tacitum; 11.23 ultimi genitive.
Own variants where the suggestion broke the mood rule: 4.4 'was unable' (not 'was it unable'), 4.7 'to deny' and 10.10 'to be' (infinitives kept), 6.2 'be' for present subjunctive sint, 6.12 adds the forced 'about'.
Metaphor/vocabulary: comata/coma 'long-haired'/'hair' (4.11-12), cinaediorem 'rather catamite-like' (10.24), mutari 'to be exchanged' (12.8), meanings moved to notes; 11.12 now carries the 'and' of -que (fixed on coordinator request).
